summary: Period 3 update covering 2017 (2017-01-01 to 2017-12-31): added 11 primary protein GWAS studies (9 published, 2 active preprints; upgraded suhre_2016_ppr29113 to suhre_2017_28240269), 13 strata, and 6,803 protein-assay records; cumulative totals: 32 studies, 40 strata, 30 cohorts, and 11,786 protein-assay records (3,769 unique human UniProt targets).
